data.narrative:
Ethos Space is a seed-stage stealth company in Space & Aerospace founded by Brogan BamBrogan, Jeff Overbeek, and Ross Centers. The valuation analysis draws from a universe of 13 comparable companies: 5 public peers (RKLB, PL, LUNR, ASTS, SATL) and 8 private firms including SpaceX, Rocket Lab, ICEYE, Sierra Space, and Planet Labs.

Standard triangulation methods prove inapplicable given data constraints. Peer-median valuation cannot be calculated—while 14 same-sector peers exist in Space & Aerospace, none satisfy minimum thresholds (same-stage, adjacent-stage, or similar-tier clustering requires ≥3 datapoints per filter), and using all-sector medians would introduce material distortion. Public-comp anchoring is likewise unavailable: the Space & Aerospace sector trades at a 27.4x median price-to-sales across the 5 public tickers, but Ethos Space's revenue is not disclosed, precluding P/S application.

This analysis cannot support a specific valuation range without either: (1) disclosed revenue or near-term revenue projections for Ethos Space, or (2) access to financing rounds or secondary transactions among seed-stage Space & Aerospace peers. The primary uncertainty is operational clarity—seed-stage space companies vary dramatically in technical maturity, capital requirements, and path to revenue. Further valuation work requires additional disclosure or market comparables from companies at similar operational stages.
